questionText: How far beyond the rejection structure is the stop placed? The rule is stated as invariant ('the same thing every single time your stop-loss is right under it') but no buffer is given in any unit - no pips, no ATR multiple, no percentage, and no statement that it sits flush against the structure. Position size = risk / stop distance, so the sizing rules remain non-computable without this number.
reason: This is the residual half of KEGAP-001. The ANCHOR is now stated for the first time in nine sources; the DISTANCE is still absent. Recorded so the gap is not reported as closed on the strength of the anchor alone.
